name: the man at the hatch
desire: get cleaned up and gone before whoever is coming comes; not to be seen
need: someone to not turn him away
fears: whoever might be coming up the road
contradictions: needs her help and cannot afford to say why he needs it — which is exactly what makes him frightening
beliefs: the less he says, the safer he is
knowledge: that he is hurt and bleeding
that he does not want to be found here
constraints: on the wrong side of the glass

lexicon: clipped; polite in a way that reads as decent OR as calculated
the words of a man choosing each one
syntax: does not explain, does not finish the dangerous sentences
avoid: anything that would tell Jo, or the reader, what he is
